purpose: High-priority State-dossier prose curation: exact domestic counter-institutions plus stable international review institutions.
identityRule: Promote only stable, disambiguated institutions/organizations whose identity is clear from dossier context. Generic labels, malformed extractor fragments, legislation/acronyms and non-enumerated functional classes remain deferred or rejected in the separate prose-disposition overlay.
explicitDeferrals: Generic `Police` mentions are not coerced into a national police identity without an exact body name.
Generic `UN Committee` mentions remain deferred until the committee is uniquely identified by the dossier.
Ukraine `TCC` remains deferred at this stage because the dossier wording describes a functional/plural recruitment-center class rather than one single canonical individual.
Malformed extractor fragments ending in `and` are reviewed as extraction artifacts rather than ontology individuals.
explicitNonGoals: Do not infer that any counter-institution is effective merely because its identity is materialized.
Do not infer State membership, control, participation or governance from international review bodies.
Do not turn constitutional-court or justice-ministry identity into a finding about the whole State.
